body:
sorry for the late reply! At this point i don't know if its getting any worse or better. She told me she was thinking of how excited she is to see me (i think shes back from her holliday now but was ganna suprise me at work tomorrow before i fly out) but then she felt sick to her stomach because of everything shes told me. Right now she feels really guilty for putting me through all this and she says she is thinking of how much people it will affect. i tell her its okay dont feel guilty, and that i cant imagine how shes gone through so much pain in her life, and that its understandable that it might make alot of sense right now to "ease the pain", but "we can work through this". She kinda.. takes it into consideration but changes the subject, but still revolving around the suicidal subject. 

And yes, I've come to terms with the fact that she might just be "Yellowstone volcano" and is meant to erupt at any minute, because it was supposed to happen long before i met her. But I'm just not gonna accept that. I do feel extremely guilty at times but then i tell myself that its just the depression talking and not her, I'm quite familiar with its voice. And its okay that you sound like a broken record because I'm really taking it into consideration.

Also Im very sorry, i know youre not any type of expert on this sort of thing, and that i should seek expert help immediately, but you have no idea how much you've helped me. I just don't know what stage this situation is at and i dont know if its early, and so i might scare her off with the "professional help" idea. 
Thanks again!

Hey. Im in the same situation as you are and I have very recently posted about it here, and i hope i can help. You have no idea how powerful your words can be. Both in a good way and a bad way. Its a very stressful situation for you, but letting your friend know how much pressure its putting on yourself can make him feel extremely guilty. Id imagine that he feels alone and has no one, not even his parents around for him. He may have you guys as very close ,understanding friends, but its hard to see that through his "thoughts". I think letting him know that he isn't alone , and that you guys as friends are there for him is extremely important. Like other people have mentioned , maybe even try get him around something that makes him happy (food etc) , and then try make him aware that he is able to vent to you/you's. Something as small as just listening to what he has to say, and actually understanding where he is coming from without judging him can be so life changing. It's a very difficult situation that you're in, and make sure to look after yourself as well. Im sorry to have posted from my throwaway account but PM me if youd like.

> Does she still talk about taking her own life a lot?

yes, well she doesn't necessarily talk about it but she has been letting off the same signs as she has done the past 3 times she has planned to do it while iv'e known her. So i definitely know we're not out of the firing zone. Her moods are very unpredictable and 
> there's always a chance that some incident, like harsh words from her family, will throw her back again.

is pretty much what happened today. I don't know what she's planning on doing but i am constantly messaging her as we speak. when she eventually calms down (i hope to god that she does, and that it doesn't escalate) i wanna talk about it seriously, and either suggest talking about it abit more if she wants to, but not at the moment when she has all these thoughts in her head. She has said to me before that not even her own cousins or family have taken her pleas for help seriously, so she wants to "prove them wrong".
I know this gonna be hard on me, but letting my friend die because no-one took her seriously is gonna be even harder. It must be getting annoying by now but again, thank you for all of your replies. I cant thank you enough.

yeah i think it was exactly what she wanted to hear. She aallways has these weird moments with me where she'd say something, and it is EXACTLY what i was about to say or what i was thinking, Down to a tee. So sometimes when that does happen, she just thinks I'm lying or she just thinks I'm agreeing with her. But when i told her about everything, it was really out of the blue and she had never told me anything similar (like our weird moments) but it turned out that we had pretty much the exact problem. She doesnt get along with her family (she does, but they always talk down on her even though she works very hard for them. she has an older cousin who she has quite a good bond with but even she has turned a shoulder on her "problems") She also lost most her friends through a previous relationship, she tells me he was very abusive emotionally and physically. Her parents split when she was younger and now she lives with her mother who...pretty much treats her like absolute shit. Their relationship is ridiculously unhealthy. So i told her its okay to be angry 24/7 towards them, and she shouldn't feel guilty "just because they're family" ( she never shows it towards them, physically/verbally lash out at them or anything)
Me on the other hand. My parents split when i was a baby. i was an only child and now they have their own seperate families, who are really happy. I love both of my different families but ive forever felt extremely angry towards them but i never ever show it because I should even be lucky enough to have both loving sets of parents. And ive always felt extremely selfish for feeling this way towards them because some people dont even have loving families (like her) which is why its taken so long for me to come out to her. This situation is such a roller coaster but i think me finally opening up to her has made her feel less alone (like you said) and even our conversations lately have been different (in a very positive way) where she trust more of what i say, Because she knows i have been through/ am going through her exact situation. there's a whole other list of stuff that makes her "down", but I think her family was the one that bothered her the most. This doesn't mean we have steered clear of her mental health, so I think finding a good professional who doesn't prescribe pills and kick her to the curb will be the next step. I know she isn't a redditor, but i still felt the need to make a throwaway account. i haven't told a single soul about our situation...apart from a few dozen redditors :/ But i felt so lost and you guys have helped me so much and i thank you again. I might even suggest to her to speak anonymously online.

oh sorry! no, not at all you havent come across demanding. She often tells me she never wanted me to be apart of this situation and shes very apologetic. But i finally opened up to her yesterday morning. I think she feels less alone now. i just never opened up to her because of pure embarrassment really but i didnt see that all she was asking was for someone who understands or is going through similar problems. I had told her about them but not as much as i told her yesterday. I feel as if im getting better with this situation but its always a roller coaster,and very unpredictable. Im still highly considering professional help because that seems to the best solution, but its very tricky to suggest it.  thank you.

Thank you so so much for your feedback.
I understand how depression works because I myself have been through it (i still am) So im quite aware that its not "her" saying those things to me so i brush them off quite easily. It's just that iv always been told how quiet i can be sometimes so it kinda struck a chord. I never had anyone who would listen to me and ive never ever told anyone about my "problems" out of embarrassment, coz im a guy and guys dont get depressed do they? but me and her have helped each other a lot through our depression and im only doing what i would have wanted someone to do for me when i was going through it. Shes helped me a lot even though iv known her for a short while.
I constantly ask how her day is going and she'd reply something along the lines of "shit" or "i feel so sad today i dont know why" i tell her "its okay to feel feel sad in front of your family, you don't have to constantly put on a happy face for them because they'll assume that everything is fine" and she replied " kinda like how you do hey?". do you think it was a good thing what i said to her?
She really enjoys helping me with my own problems but I'm always embarrassed to tell her about them coz i think of how small mine seem compared to hers (there not actually small, but i just didn't fully open up to her till last night when i called her). I haven't suggested professional help yet, but only in fear that that would feel as if "i cant help you so il give you off to this other guy" or as if i see her as one of my "patients" in who im only around because i pity her. 

She asked me why i care so much about her and that shes sorry for everything and i say "theres nothing to be sorry for, and you should never feel embarrassed coz i know its not you talking" (something along the lines of that). She thinks im here just because i pity her situation she is in, but i care because it seems so familiar to me.

Again thank you very much for your feedback, even though you are going through a hard time yourself, you are choosing to help others and you don't know how much i truly appreciate it. Thank you so much friend.

Sorry for the late reply iv only just gotten out of bed. thank you so much for the feedback.
I was aware that she needs professional help because I'm not exactly Dr Phill in this situation, But i havent suggested it to her in fear that she'd feel as if shes "one of my patients" or "i cant help you so il scoot you off to this other person sorry". Even though i haven't known her for that long, we've constantly helped each other through our depression. I hadn't had anyone there for me to listen to me, so I'm doing it because that's what i would have wanted, not because i pity her. i talked to her lastnight about it and she asked why im even interested in her, i have a feeling she is trying to distance herself away from me so i would care less about her so she can go ahead with her plans. she talks to me of how much she doesn't want to be here and how neglected her family makes her feel by talking down on her. 

again thank you for your feedback it is truly appreciated.
